title: Google Sign-In: Let Users Sign In With Google | Orchard Core
description:
People who already have a Google Account have to create and remember another password to sign in to a site.

The Google Authentication feature of Orchard Core adds a Google button to the login page. You enter the Client ID and the client secret from the Google API console, save the settings, and people can sign in with their Google Account. The credentials in this video are fake.

In this video:
• How Google sign-in works
• Enable the feature
• Enter the credentials
• The login page
• Related settings
